purpose: Test whether V102's seed-dependent LoadLeast initializer regressions are caused by compensating losses inside the scalar FaaSRank admissibility score, using nested outcome-blind per-substitution safety gates and exact V94 coordination.

conditional_certificate_identical_to_ini.interpretation: The conditional LoadLeast coordination certificate is behaviorally inert in V102; the initializer is the identified causal treatment.

accepted_initializer_evidence.path_dependence: A small number of accepted nonterminal substitutions changed thousands of later final assignment windows through persistent container and queue state.
accepted_initializer_evidence.scalar_compensation_risk: The frozen FaaSRank admissibility score is a weighted sum of CPU headroom, memory headroom, current-parent locality, warm affinity, load balance, and diversity. A candidate can pass the scalar noninferiority gate while losing one operationally important component.
accepted_initializer_evidence.completed_request_stage_metrics_are_not_: Post-hoc communication and wait components were mixed and completion-selected; they motivate a mechanism test but cannot define an online or result-dependent gate.

frozen_formal_V94_gap.interpretation: The optimization target is QPR improvement without surrendering the already-leading V94 throughput.

closed_alternatives.conditional_LoadLeast_window_certificate: closed as behaviorally inert by V102
closed_alternatives.density_threshold_search: closed as an insufficient separator by V101 and the revealed V102 accepted-window audit
closed_alternatives.scenario_or_burst_label_router: forbidden because workload labels are outside the online information boundary
closed_alternatives.completion_or_QPR_feedback: forbidden because completed-request outcomes and selection metrics are outside the online information boundary

allowed_online_inputs: current pending plus resident task count by node
current node CPU and memory utilization snapshots
current parent-function placements and immutable parent output sizes
current link bandwidth snapshot used by the frozen FaaSRank locality component
current running or existing container membership for the player function
frozen terminal-OCS or nonterminal-FaaSRank routed score

arms.per_substitution_safety: V102 scalar routed-score noninferiority plus candidate current-parent locality no worse than the frozen anchor
arms.coordination_guard: exact V94 dual window-safe Pareto guard

arms.per_substitution_safety: V102 scalar routed-score noninferiority plus componentwise noninferiority in CPU headroom, memory headroom, current-parent locality, warm affinity, and diversity penalty; LoadLeast projected load remains strictly improved
arms.coordination_guard: exact V94 dual window-safe Pareto guard

candidate_mechanism.player_order: retain the exact V94 SRPT-ready order
candidate_mechanism.density_band: retain V102 eligibility: nonterminal substitutions only at queue density >=8 and every substitution only while whole-window density <24
candidate_mechanism.strict_load_improvement: candidate pending plus resident plus same-window projected count is strictly below anchor
candidate_mechanism.warm_preservation_common_floor: retain V102: a running-warm anchor may only move to a running-warm candidate
candidate_mechanism.input_locality_gate: candidate frozen FaaSRank current-parent locality component must be at least anchor locality within EPSILON
componentwise_gate: candidate CPU headroom at least anchor CPU headroom within EPSILON
candidate memory headroom at least anchor memory headroom within EPSILON
candidate current-parent locality at least anchor locality within EPSILON
candidate warm affinity at least anchor warm affinity within EPSILON
candidate diversity penalty no greater than anchor diversity penalty within EPSILON
candidate LoadLeast projected load strictly below anchor, which also strictly improves the frozen FaaSRank load-balance component
complete_initializer_acceptance: at least one structurally safe substitution
candidate_mechanism.coordination_acceptance: exact V94 dual window-safe Pareto guard with no LoadLeast certificate
candidate_mechanism.exact_anchor_invariant: When no initializer substitution is accepted, each V103 candidate dispatches exactly the V94 assignment for identical current state and candidates.

selection.throughput_gate_per_scenario: candidate three-seed mean is at least the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is nonnegative on at least two of three seeds
selection.qpr_gate_per_scenario_per_convention: candidate three-seed mean is strictly greater than the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is strictly positive on at least two of three seeds
selection.E3_winner_requires: one candidate passes all three metrics in all three E3 scenarios
selection.multiple_passers: maximize the minimum relative mean QPR gain across scenarios and conventions, then maximize the minimum relative throughput change, then prefer componentwise-pareto over input-locality-pareto, then arm_id
selection.frozen_E4_component: V97 v97-e4-load-guard64; no V103 E4 arm or result-dependent E4 reselection
selection.E3_pass_authorizes_only: a separately committed E946-E965 all-20-seed confirmation plan pairing the selected E3 profile with the already frozen V97 E4 profile
selection.failure_action: Freeze all 27 runs, keep E926-E965 and every other unopened seed untouched, do not replace seeds or selectively rerun scientific results, and return to mechanism diagnosis.
